{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GV9aes3UJ3V1dAX1nUkbgT","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Conversion between two currencies on a calendar day, in exact decimal arithmetic.\n\nThe base currency EUR has the implicit rate 1; any other rate is the stored ECB text read as a\nDecimal. The pair rate is rate(to) / rate(from), rounded half to even to six decimals. The result is\namount * rate(to) / rate(from), computed exactly from the stored rates and then rounded half to even\nto two decimals, so it never depends on the rounded pair rate. No floating point is used.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nfrom fxrates_app import rates as rate_service\n\nRATE_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.000001\")\nRESULT_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.01\")\n\n\nclass UnknownCurrency(LookupError):\n    \"\"\"A currency other than the base has no stored rate on the effective publication.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UnusableRate(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A stored rate is zero, so it cannot be used as a divisor.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _rate_of(code: str, rates: dict[str, str]) -> Decimal:\n    \"\"\"Return the Decimal rate of `code` against the base; the base itself is 1.\"\"\"\n    if code == rate_service.BASE:\n        return Decimal(1)\n    if code not in rates:\n        raise UnknownCurrency(code)\n    value = Decimal(rates[code])\n    if value == 0:\n        raise UnusableRate(code)\n    return value\n\n\ndef convert(source: str, target: str, amount: str, requested: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"Convert `amount` of `source` into `target` using the effective publication.\n\n    `requested` is a calendar date; None selects the latest publication. Returns None when no\n    publication exists on or before the requested date.\n    \"\"\"\n    found = rate_service.latest_rates() if requested is None else rate_service.rates_on(requested)\n    if found is None:\n        return None\n    effective, rates = found\n    rate_from = _rate_of(source, rates)\n    rate_to = _rate_of(target, rates)\n    rate = (rate_to / rate_from).quantize(RATE_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    result = (Decimal(amount) * rate_to / rate_from).quantize(RESULT_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    return {\n        \"date\": effective,\n        \"from\": source,\n        \"to\": target,\n        \"amount\": amount,\n        \"rate\": f\"{rate:.6f}\",\n        \"result\": f\"{result:.2f}\",\n    }\n---HISTORY---\n\"\"\"A currency's stored rates over a period, ascending by date, returned as the stored text.\n\nPoints come from `db.rates.list_currency_history` in one call per request, so a load completed\nbefore the request is visible to it. Both bounds are optional and inclusive; a start later than the\nend matches nothing. Rates are never converted to a number.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\n\ndef history_points(code: str, start: str | None = None, end: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return {\"date\", \"rate\"} points for `code` from `start` through `end`, ascending by date.\"\"\"\n    arguments: dict[str, str] = {\"currency\": code}\n    if start is not None:\n        arguments[\"start_date\"] = start\n    if end is not None:\n        arguments[\"end_date\"] = end\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_currency_history(**arguments)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return [{\"date\": row.date, \"rate\": row.rate} for row in rows]\n---STATS---\n\"\"\"Summary of the store: how many dates and rates it holds, and its first and last publication dates.\n\nEvery value is derived from `db.rates.list_all_keys`; the service counts and takes the extremes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\n\ndef stats() -> dict[str, int | str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Return the dates and rates counts and the first and last dates, None when nothing is stored.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        keys = db.rates.list_all_keys()\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    dates = sorted({key.date for key in keys})\n    return {\n        \"dates\": len(dates),\n        \"rates\": len(keys),\n        \"first\": dates[0] if dates else None,\n        \"last\": dates[-1] if dates else None,\n    }\n---ROUTES---\n\"\"\"Shared router registry. Feature stories attach their routes here; static routes go first.\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query\n\nfrom fxrates_app import convert as convert_service\nfrom fxrates_app import currencies as currency_service\nfrom fxrates_app import history as history_service\nfrom fxrates_app import rates as rate_service\nfrom fxrates_app import stats as stats_service\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\nDATE_PATTERN = r\"^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$\"\nAMOUNT_PATTERN = r\"^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$\"\n\n\ndef _calendar_date(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return `value` as an ISO calendar date; 422 for a well-formed string that is not a real date.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return datetime.date.fromisoformat(value).isoformat()\n    except ValueError as error:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f\"not a real calendar date: {value}\") from error\n\n\n@router.get(\"/health\")\ndef health() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Liveness probe. It reaches no store, so it answers even when the database is absent.\"\"\"\n    return {\"status\": \"ok\"}\n\n\n@router.get(\"/stats\")\ndef stats() -> dict[str, int | str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Counts of stored dates and rates, and the first and last publication dates.\"\"\"\n    return stats_service.stats()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/currencies\")\ndef currencies() -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"The base currency and every stored currency code, ascending.\"\"\"\n    return {\"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"currencies\": currency_service.currencies()}\n\n\n@router.get(\"/rates/latest\")\ndef rates_latest() -> dict[str, str | dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The rates of the latest publication, with requested \"latest\"; 404 when nothing is stored.\"\"\"\n    found = rate_service.latest_rates()\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"no publication is stored\")\n    effective, rates = found\n    return {\"date\": effective, \"requested\": \"latest\", \"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"rates\": rates}\n\n\n@router.get(\"/rates/{date}\")\ndef rates_on_date(date: Annotated[str, Path(pattern=DATE_PATTERN)]) -> dict[str, str | dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The rates of the latest publication on or before `date`; 422 for an impossible date, 404 when none exists.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        requested = datetime.date.fromisoformat(date).isoformat()\n    except ValueError as error:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f\"not a real calendar date: {date}\") from error\n    found = rate_service.rates_on(requested)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f\"no publication on or before {requested}\")\n    effective, rates = found\n    return {\"date\": effective, \"requested\": requested, \"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"rates\": rates}\n\n\n@router.get(\"/convert\")\ndef convert_amount(\n    source: Annotated[str, Query(alias=\"from\")],\n    target: Annotated[str, Query(alias=\"to\")],\n    amount: Annotated[str, Query(pattern=AMOUNT_PATTERN)],\n    date: Annotated[str | None, Query(pattern=DATE_PATTERN)] = None,\n) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Convert `amount` from one currency to another on `date`, or on the latest publication when omitted.\"\"\"\n    requested = None if date is None else _calendar_date(date)\n    try:\n        converted = convert_service.convert(source, target, amount, requested)\n    except convert_service.UnknownCurrency as error:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f\"no stored rate for {error}\") from error\n    except convert_service.UnusableRate as error:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f\"stored rate is zero for {error}\") from error\n    if converted is None:\n        detail = \"no publication is stored\" if requested is None else f\"no publication on or before {requested}\"\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=detail)\n    return converted\n\n\n@router.get(\"/history/{code}\")\ndef history(\n    code: str,\n    start: Annotated[str | None, Query(pattern=DATE_PATTERN)] = None,\n    end: Annotated[str | None, Query(pattern=DATE_PATTERN)] = None,\n) -> dict[str, str | int | list[dict[str, str]]]:\n    \"\"\"A currency's stored rates from `start` through `end` inclusive, ascending by date.\"\"\"\n    lower = None if start is None else _calendar_date(start)\n    upper = None if end is None else _calendar_date(end)\n    points = history_service.history_points(code, lower, upper)\n    return {\"currency\": code, \"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"count\": len(points), \"points\": points}\n---MAIN---\n\"\"\"FastAPI application factory and the module-level app for `uvicorn app_server.main:app`.\"\"\"\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\n\nfrom app_server import routes\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    \"\"\"Build a new FastAPI application that includes the shared router.\"\"\"\n    application = FastAPI()\n    application.include_router(routes.router)\n    return application\n\n\napp = create_app()\n---RATES---\n\"\"\"Rates on a calendar day: the effective publication date and the rates published on it.\n\nThe ECB publishes on working days only, so a request for any date resolves to the latest\npublication on or before it. Rates are returned as the stored text, never converted to a float.\nReads go through `db.rates` only.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\nBASE = \"EUR\"\n\n\ndef _effective(db: Database, day: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest stored publication date on or before `day`, or None when none exists.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before(as_of=day)\n    return rows[0].date if rows else None\n\n\ndef effective_date(d: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest publication date on or before `d`, or None when no such date exists.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        return _effective(db, d)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\ndef _rates_of(db: Database, effective: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return {currency: stored rate text} for the publication on `effective`, base excluded.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_for_date(date=effective)\n    return {row.currency: row.rate for row in rows if row.currency != BASE}\n\n\ndef rates_on(requested: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (effective date, {currency: stored rate text}) for `requested`, or None.\n\n    None means no publication exists on or before `requested`. The base currency never appears in\n    the mapping.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        effective = _effective(db, requested)\n        if effective is None:\n            return None\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n\n\ndef latest_rates() -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (latest publication date, {currency: stored rate text}), or None when nothing is stored.\n\n    The latest date is the first row of `list_on_or_before` called without a bound.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before()\n        if not rows:\n            return None\n        effective = rows[0].date\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n---CONFIG---\n\"\"\"Database location: one place decides which store the application opens.\n\nResolution order: DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db. The environment is read at\ncall time. Application code opens the store only through `persistence.open_database`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\n\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\nSQLITE_PREFIX = \"sqlite://\"\n\n\ndef database_path() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the database location from the environment, falling back to data/app.db.\"\"\"\n    url = os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_URL\", \"\")\n    if url.startswith(SQLITE_PREFIX):\n        url = url[len(SQLITE_PREFIX):]\n    if url:\n        return url\n    path = os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_PATH\", \"\")\n    if path:\n        return path\n    return DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n\n\ndef open_store() -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the store named by `database_path()` through the persistence library.\"\"\"\n    return open_database(database_path())","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3fc3a4bc-4a08-465a-8595-fa287f19e6d0","uuid":"a29b55a4-9b98-432a-89ec-6633916464e9","timestamp":"2026-10-27T16:49:27.274Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Conversion between two currencies on a calendar day, in exact decimal arithmetic.\n\nThe base currency EUR has the implicit rate 1; any other rate is the stored ECB text read as a\nDecimal. lower, upper)\n    return {\"currency\": code, \"base\": rate_service.BASE, \"count\": len(points), \"points\": points}\n---MAIN---\n\"\"\"FastAPI application factory and the module-level app for `uvicorn app_server.main:app`.\"\"\"\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\n\nfrom app_server import routes\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    \"\"\"Build a new FastAPI application that includes the shared router.\"\"\"\n    application = FastAPI()\n    application.include_router(routes.router)\n    return application\n\n\napp = create_app()\n---RATES---\n\"\"\"Rates on a calendar day: the effective publication date and the rates published on it.\n\nThe ECB publishes on working days only, so a request for any date resolves to the latest\npublication on or before it. Rates are returned as the stored text, never converted to a float.\nReads go through `db.rates` only.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\nBASE = \"EUR\"\n\n\ndef _effective(db: Database, day: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest stored publication date on or before `day`, or None when none exists.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before(as_of=day)\n    return rows[0].date if rows else None\n\n\ndef effective_date(d: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the latest publication date on or before `d`, or None when no such date exists.\"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        return _effective(db, d)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\ndef _rates_of(db: Database, effective: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return {currency: stored rate text} for the publication on `effective`, base excluded.\"\"\"\n    rows = db.rates.list_for_date(date=effective)\n    return {row.currency: row.rate for row in rows if row.currency != BASE}\n\n\ndef rates_on(requested: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (effective date, {currency: stored rate text}) for `requested`, or None.\n\n    None means no publication exists on or before `requested`. The base currency never appears in\n    the mapping.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        effective = _effective(db, requested)\n        if effective is None:\n            return None\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n\n\ndef latest_rates() -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return (latest publication date, {currency: stored rate text}), or None when nothing is stored.\n\n    The latest date is the first row of `list_on_or_before` called without a bound.\n    \"\"\"\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_on_or_before()\n        if not rows:\n            return None\n        effective = rows[0].date\n        rates = _rates_of(db, effective)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return effective, rates\n---CONFIG---\n\"\"\"Database location: one place decides which store the application opens.\n\nResolution order: DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db. The environment is read at\ncall time. Application code opens the store only through `persistence.open_database`.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\n\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\nSQLITE_PREFIX = \"sqlite://\"\n\n\ndef database_path() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the database location from the environment, falling back to data/app.db.\"\"\"\n    url = os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_URL\", \"\")\n    if url.startswith(SQLITE_PREFIX):\n        url = url[len(SQLITE_PREFIX):]\n    if url:\n        return url\n    path = os.environ.get(\"DATABASE_PATH\", \"\")\n    if path:\n        return path\n    return DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n\n\ndef open_store() -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the store named by `database_path()` through the persistence library.\"\"\"\n    return open_database(database_path())","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01GV9aes3UJ3V1dAX1nUkbgT","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CPfoeekdUAusxDSvboZH38","type":"tool_result","content":"#!/bin/sh\n# CommandCenter Operation\n# Name: Run Test Suite\n# Type: batch\n\n# --- Standard Preamble ---\nset -eu\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/data/logs\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')\nSCRIPT_NAME=$(basename \"$0\" .sh)\nLOG_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.log\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Arguments: $*\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Working dir: $PROJECT_DIR\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"---\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\ncd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n\nif [ ! -f \".venv/bin/activate\" ]; then\n    echo \"Environment missing: run 'uv sync' in $PROJECT_DIR first\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# --- Run the declared test_command: pytest -q ---\n# Calls the environment's pytest directly; sourcing activate trips `set -u`. Output is captured\n# in full so the exit status of pytest is kept (a pipe would hide it).\nset +e\n\"$PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/pytest\" -q >\"$LOG_FILE.pytest\" 2>&1\nSTATUS=$?\nset -e\ncat \"$LOG_FILE.pytest\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nrm -f \"$LOG_FILE.pytest\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME finished at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') with status $STATUS ===\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nexit \"$STATUS\"\n---TESTS_CONVERT---\n\"\"\"GET /convert and fxrates_app.convert: exact decimal conversion rounded half to even.\n\nEach test shares one acceptance transaction with the web client and rolls back at the end. Tests\nthat depend on which publications exist start from an emptied store inside that transaction, and\nexpected values are derived with Decimal from the seeded rates.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom fxrates_app import convert as convert_service\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef rolled_back_transaction() -> Iterator[None]:\n    \"\"\"Share one connection between the route and the test, then roll everything back.\"\"\"\n    persistence_db.begin_acceptance_transaction()\n    try:\n        yield\n    finally:\n        persistence_db.end_acceptance_transaction()\n\n\ndef empty_store(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef test_two_currencies_convert_with_six_and_two_decimals(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-01-01\"\n    rate_from = \"1.0298\"\n    rate_to = \"0.84453\"\n    amount = \"100\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=rate_from)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZB\", rate=rate_to)\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"ZZB\", \"amount\": amount, \"date\": d})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    expected_rate = (Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(Decimal(\"0.000001\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    expected_result = (Decimal(amount) * Decimal(rate_to) / Decimal(rate_from)).quantize(\n        Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN\n    )\n    assert response.json() == {\n        \"date\": d,\n        \"from\": \"ZZA\",\n        \"to\": \"ZZB\",\n        \"amount\": amount,\n        \"rate\": f\"{expected_rate:.6f}\",\n        \"result\": f\"{expected_result:.2f}\",\n    }\n\n\ndef test_amount_is_echoed_as_given(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-01-02\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"EUR\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"007.50\", \"date\": d}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"amount\"] == \"007.50\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"15.00\"\n\n\ndef test_eur_to_stored_currency_uses_rate_one_for_eur(web_client) -> None:\n    published = \"2999-02-01\"\n    requested = \"2999-02-03\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=published, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"161.77\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\n            \"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"EUR\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"250.25\", \"date\": requested}\n        ).json()\n\n    assert body[\"date\"] == published\n    assert body[\"rate\"] == \"161.770000\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"40482.94\"\n\n\ndef test_stored_currency_to_eur_divides_by_the_stored_rate(web_client) -> None:\n    published = \"2999-02-01\"\n    requested = \"2999-02-03\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=published, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"161.77\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\n            \"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"EUR\", \"amount\": \"1000\", \"date\": requested}\n        ).json()\n\n    expected_rate = (Decimal(1) / Decimal(\"161.77\")).quantize(Decimal(\"0.000001\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    expected_result = (Decimal(\"1000\") / Decimal(\"161.77\")).quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    assert body[\"date\"] == published\n    assert body[\"rate\"] == f\"{expected_rate:.6f}\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == f\"{expected_result:.2f}\"\n\n\ndef test_without_date_the_latest_publication_is_used(web_client) -> None:\n    older = \"2999-03-01\"\n    newest = \"2999-03-09\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=older, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=older, currency=\"ZZB\", rate=\"3\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=newest, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"2\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=newest, currency=\"ZZB\", rate=\"5\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"ZZB\", \"amount\": \"2.00\"}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"date\"] == newest\n    assert body[\"rate\"] == \"2.500000\"\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"5.00\"\n\n\ndef test_date_between_publications_resolves_to_the_earlier_one(web_client) -> None:\n    early = \"2999-04-01\"\n    late = \"2999-04-05\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=early, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"4\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=late, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"8\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"EUR\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"1\", \"date\": \"2999-04-03\"}).json()\n\n    assert body[\"date\"] == early\n    assert body[\"result\"] == \"4.00\"\n\n\ndef test_same_currency_gives_rate_one_and_rounds_the_amount(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-05-01\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1.5\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"0.125\", \"date\": d}).json()\n\n create_app\n\n\ndef test_create_app_returns_a_fastapi_instance() -> None:\n    assert isinstance(create_app(), FastAPI)\n\n\ndef test_create_app_returns_a_new_instance_each_call() -> None:\n    assert create_app() is not create_app()\n\n\ndef test_module_level_app_is_a_fastapi_instance() -> None:\n    assert isinstance(app, FastAPI)\n\n\ndef test_router_registry_is_an_apirouter() -> None:\n    assert isinstance(routes.router, APIRouter)\n\n\ndef test_routes_on_the_registry_are_served_by_created_apps(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:\n    registry = APIRouter()\n\n    @registry.get(\"/probe\")\n    def probe() -> dict[str, bool]:\n        return {\"ok\": True}\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(routes, \"router\", registry)\n\n    response = TestClient(create_app()).get(\"/probe\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.json() == {\"ok\": True}\n\n\ndef test_web_client_returns_a_testclient_wrapping_a_fastapi_app() response.json()[\"openapi\"].startswith(\"3.\")\n\n\ndef test_docs_page_is_served(web_client) -> None:\n    response = web_client.get(\"/docs\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n\n\ndef Both bounds are optional and inclusive; a start later than the\nend matches nothing. Rates are never converted to a float: the statistics compare and average them\nas `Decimal`, and min and max return the stored text unchanged.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\nMEAN_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.000001\")\n\n\ndef history_points(code: str, start: str | None = None, end: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return {\"date\", \"rate\"} points for `code` from `start` through `end`, ascending by date.\"\"\"\n    arguments: dict[str, str] = {\"currency\": code}\n    if start is not None:\n        arguments[\"start_date\"] = start\n    if end is not None:\n        arguments[\"end_date\"] = end\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_currency_history(**arguments)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return [{\"date\": row.date, \"rate\": row.rate} for row in rows]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":28,"oldLines":3,"newStart":28,"newLines":21,"lines":["     finally:","         db.close()","     return [{\"date\": row.date, \"rate\": row.rate} for row in rows]","+","+","+def history_summary(points: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, int | str | None]:","+    \"\"\"Return count, min, max, and mean over `points`; (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3fc3a4bc-4a08-465a-8595-fa287f19e6d0","uuid":"598968e0-aa49-497f-8bfe-9021fdda20ab","timestamp":"2026-10-27T16:50:20.133Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/fxrates_app/history.py","oldString":"    values = [(Decimal(point[\"rate\"]), point[\"rate\"]) for point in points]\n    total = sum((value for value, _ in values), Decimal(0))\n    mean = (total / len(values)).quantize(MEAN_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    return {\n        \"count\": len(points),\n        \"min\": min(values, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[1],\n        \"max\": max(values, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[1],\n        \"mean\": f\"{mean:.6f}\",\n    }","newString":"    total = sum((Decimal(point[\"rate\"]) for point in points), Decimal(0))\n    mean = (total / len(points)).quantize(MEAN_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    return {\n        \"count\": len(points),\n        \"min\": min(points, key=lambda point: Decimal(point[\"rate\"]))[\"rate\"],\n        \"max\": max(points, key=lambda point: Decimal(point[\"rate\"]))[\"rate\"],\n        \"mean\": f\"{mean:.6f}\",\n    }","originalFile":"\"\"\"A currency's stored rates over a period, ascending by date, returned as the stored text.\n\nPoints come from `db.rates.list_currency_history` in one call per request, so a load completed\nbefore the request is visible to it. Both bounds are optional and inclusive; a start later than the\nend matches nothing. Rates are never converted to a float: the statistics compare and average them\nas `Decimal`, and min and max return the stored text unchanged.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Decimal\n\nfrom fxrates_app.config import open_store\n\nMEAN_QUANTUM = Decimal(\"0.000001\")\n\n\ndef history_points(code: str, start: str | None = None, end: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return {\"date\", \"rate\"} points for `code` from `start` through `end`, ascending by date.\"\"\"\n    arguments: dict[str, str] = {\"currency\": code}\n    if start is not None:\n        arguments[\"start_date\"] = start\n    if end is not None:\n        arguments[\"end_date\"] = end\n    db = open_store()\n    try:\n        rows = db.rates.list_currency_history(**arguments)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n    return [{\"date\": row.date, \"rate\": row.rate} for row in rows]\n\n\ndef history_summary(points: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, int | str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Return count, min, max, and mean over `points`; min and max are stored text, mean has six decimals.\n\n    With no points, count is 0 and min, max, and mean are None.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not points:\n        return {\"count\": 0, \"min\": None, \"max\": None, \"mean\": None}\n    values = [(Decimal(point[\"rate\"]), point[\"rate\"]) for point in points]\n    total = sum((value for value, _ in values), Decimal(0))\n    mean = (total / len(values)).quantize(MEAN_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)\n    return {\n        \"count\": len(points),\n        \"min\": min(values, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[1],\n        \"max\": max(values, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[1],\n        \"mean\": f\"{mean:.6f}\",\n    }\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":37,"oldLines":12,"newStart":37,"newLines":11,"lines":["     \"\"\"","     if not points:","         return {\"count\": 0, \"min\": None, \"max\": None, \"mean\": None}","-    values = [(Decimal(point[\"rate\"]), point[\"rate\"]) for point in points]","-    total = sum((value for value, _ in values), Decimal(0))","-    mean = (total / len(values)).quantize(MEAN_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)","+    total = sum((Decimal(point[\"rate\"]) for point in points), Decimal(0))","+    mean = (total / len(points)).quantize(MEAN_QUANTUM, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)","     return {","         \"count\": len(points),","-        \"min\": min(values, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[1],","-        \"max\": max(values, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[1],","+        \"min\": min(points, key=lambda point: Decimal(point[\"rate\"]))[\"rate\"],","+        \"max\": max(points, key=lambda point: Decimal(point[\"rate\"]))[\"rate\"],","         \"mean\": f\"{mean:.6f}\",","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_016XmaAkDbs8yKaC2xYz2hMt","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef mean_of(texts: list[str]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the exact mean of `texts`, rounded half to even at six decimals, with six decimals.\"\"\"\n    total = sum(Decimal(text) for text in texts)\n    return f\"{(total / len(texts)).quantize(Decimal('0.000001'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN):.6f}\"\n\n\ndef test_count_is_the_number_of_points(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    rates = {\n        \"1900-12-01\": \"0.9453\",\n        \"1900-12-02\": \"0.943\",\n        \"1900-12-03\": \"0.9441\",\n        \"1900-12-04\": \"10.5\",\n        \"1900-12-05\": \"9.75\",\n    }\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        for d, r in rates.items():\n            db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=r)\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"count\"] == len(rates)\n\n\ndef test_min_is_the_smallest_rate_by_decimal_value_as_stored_text(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    rates = {\"1900-12-01\": \"0.9453\", \"1900-12-02\": \"0.943\", \"1900-12-04\": \"10.5\", \"1900-12-05\": \"9.75\"}\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        for d, r in rates.items():\n            db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=r)\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"min\"] == \"0.943\"\n\n\ndef test_max_is_the_largest_rate_by_decimal_value_as_stored_text(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    rates = {\"1900-12-01\": \"0.9453\", \"1900-12-02\": \"0.943\", \"1900-12-04\": \"10.5\", \"1900-12-05\": \"9.75\"}\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        for d, r in rates.items():\n            db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=r)\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"max\"] == \"10.5\"\n\n\ndef test_min_and_max_keep_trailing_zeros_of_the_stored_text(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZH\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1900-12-06\", currency=code, rate=\"2.50\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1900-12-07\", currency=code, rate=\"3.000\")\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"min\"] == \"2.50\"\n    assert body[\"max\"] == \"3.000\"\n\n\ndef test_mean_is_half_even_at_six_decimals_for_the_first_tie(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZM\"\n    rates = {\"1901-01-01\": \"1.000000\", \"1901-01-02\": \"1.000001\"}\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        for d, r in rates.items():\n            db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=r)\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"mean\"] == mean_of(list(rates.values()))\n    assert body[\"mean\"] == \"1.000000\"\n\n\ndef test_mean_is_half_even_at_six_decimals_for_the_second_tie(web_client) -> None:\n    code = db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=code, rate=r)\n\n        body = web_client.get(f\"/history/{code}\").json()\n\n    assert body[\"mean\"] == mean_of(list(rates.values()))\n    assert body[\"mean\"] == \"1.000002\"\n\n\ndef test_mean_is_written_with_exactly_six_decimals(web_client) -> None:\n    code = \"ZZP\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1901-01-03\", currency=code, rate=\"2\")\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"1901-01-04\", currency=code, rate=\"3\")\n\n        body = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgT5y8VfyLe7U4JDnW1E7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QbeGbD3fHoqZbQsyxsedLz","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/FxRates/runs/20261027.152427/build/FxRates/tests/test_convert_errors.py","content":"\"\"\"GET /convert refusals: unknown currencies answer 404, bad or missing inputs answer 422.\n\nEach test shares one acceptance transaction with the web client and rolls back at the end. The\nstatus code is the oracle; no test reads the error body, whose wording is not part of the contract.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef rolled_back_transaction() -> Iterator[None]:\n    \"\"\"Share one connection between the route and the test, then roll everything back.\"\"\"\n    persistence_db.begin_acceptance_transaction()\n    try:\n        yield\n    finally:\n        persistence_db.end_acceptance_transaction()\n\n\ndef empty_store(db) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every stored rate inside the acceptance transaction.\"\"\"\n    db.rates.delete_from_date(from_date=\"0000-01-01\")\n\n\ndef test_unknown_source_currency_is_not_found(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-05-01\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1.5\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZX\", \"to\": \"ZZA\", \"amount\": \"1\", \"date\": d})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_unknown_target_currency_is_not_found(web_client) -> None:\n    d = \"2999-05-01\"\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=d, currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1.5\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"ZZX\", \"amount\": \"1\", \"date\": d})\n\n    assert response.status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_date_earlier_than_every_publication_is_not_found_for_a_stored_currency(web_client) -> None:\n    with db_session() as db:\n        empty_store(db)\n        db.rates.replace_rate(date=\"2999-06-01\", currency=\"ZZA\", rate=\"1.5\")\n\n        response = web_client.get(\"/convert\", params={\"from\": \"ZZA\", \"to\": \"EUR\",
